immutable_rule: After this file is hashed, thresholds and success rules may not be weakened. A code defect may be corrected only in a hashed amendment written before rerunning the affected candidate.

confirmation.reveal_rule: Only the confirm stage, after validating the frozen manifest, may copy the committed bank from .git/v7_confirmation_seeds.json into the result archive.

seed_banks.disjointness: Every integer in every triple must be pairwise disjoint across all banks and from the V6 ledger. Tested before any run.

data.input_distribution: iid Uniform[-1,1] generated only by the downstream experiment layer

simulators.exact: AerSimulator(method='density_matrix') with save_expectation_value instructions on replayed QuantumCircuits
simulators.finite_shot: AerSimulator measurements and complete joint count dictionaries; all Z-product observables in a group are parities of the same bitstrings
simulators.backend_noise: NoiseModel.from_backend(current installed fake backend), with transpilation to that backend target

readouts.raw_ols: LinearRegression on raw persisted Aer features
readouts.ridge_cv: StandardScaler then RidgeCV over [1e-6,1e-4,1e-2,1,100] using training data only
readouts.whitened_ols: training-SVD orthonormal feature coordinates, relative cutoff 1e-10, then OLS
readouts.capacity: 1 - test MSE / training-mean test target sum of squares; never clipped

metrics.memory_M: sum of held-out linear capacities for delays 1..12 using memory-local features
metrics.nonlinearity_N: sum of held-out current-input Legendre degree 2, 3, and 4 capacities using processor-local features
metrics.nonlinear_degree_profile: the three individual current degree capacities
metrics.delayed_nonlinear: degree 2, 3, and 4 capacities at every delay 1..12
metrics.combined: current nonlinear x delayed linear, delayed nonlinear, delayed x delayed, and delayed cubic families

statistics.confidence: paired seed bootstrap with 20000 resamples and Bonferroni simultaneous bounds across mandatory components
statistics.equivalence: two one-sided tests represented by a simultaneous confidence interval wholly inside the equivalence margin
statistics.confirmation_alpha_spending: attempt k uses alpha 0.01/2^(k-1); failed banks are archived and never reused

mandatory_gates.01_memory_main: M(m=1)-M(m=0) >= 0.15 and simultaneous lower bound >= 0.10 for every readout and exact/finite-shot modes
mandatory_gates.02_nonlinearity_main: N(g=1)-N(g=0) >= 0.15 and simultaneous lower bound >= 0.10 for every readout and exact/finite-shot modes
mandatory_gates.03_memory_to_nonlinearity_cross: paired confidence interval for N(m=1)-N(m=0) lies inside +/-0.05
mandatory_gates.04_nonlinearity_to_memory_cross: paired confidence interval for M(g=1)-M(g=0) lies inside +/-0.05
mandatory_gates.05_profile_preservation: all nonlinear-degree components under m and all 12 memory-curve components under g satisfy simultaneous +/-0.06 equivalence
mandatory_gates.06_scale_invariance: 01-05 pass for raw, standardized, ridge-CV, whitened, exact, and finite-shot analyses
mandatory_gates.07_geometry: normalized exact feature geometry changes with g (linear CKA <= 0.98), while the amplitude-rescaled control has CKA 1 within 1e-10
mandatory_gates.08_combined_hh: for every claimed family/mode/readout HH exceeds max(LL,LH,HL) by 0.03 and its simultaneous lower bound is positive
mandatory_gates.09_per_delay_tail: at least 75% of claimed delays meet 0.03 and every delay 9..12 has capacity >=0.01; report all delays 1..12
mandatory_gates.10_negative_controls: future, permuted, destroyed-order, and random-label capacities <=0.10; reset/disabled/disconnected controls remove the corresponding effect
mandatory_gates.11_no_leakage_saturation: chronological disjoint split, no future/target feature, aggregate metric below 11.5, and no more than 20% constituents exceed 0.995
mandatory_gates.12_backend_robustness: main effects and HH ordering retain at least 50% of ideal effect under fake-backend circuit-level noise, both transpiler seeds, both simulator seeds
mandatory_gates.13_precision_shots: qualitative gate decisions agree for single/double precision and 1000/10000/100000 shots where run
mandatory_gates.14_validation: all gates pass unchanged on internal-validation seeds
mandatory_gates.15_confirmation: all gates pass once on the untouched revealed confirmation bank at the allocated alpha

candidate_rule: A candidate failing any mandatory development gate is rejected and archived. Only a candidate passing development and internal validation with thresholds unchanged may be frozen and see confirmation data. Quantum advantage is a separate claim and requires superiority to all matched baselines.
